title: oreobatus neomexicanus
intro: Oreobatus neomexicanus, commonly known as the New Mexico locoweed, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It is a perennial herb that produces clusters of small, pink or purple flowers. The health benefits of Oreobatus neomexicanus include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its rich content of flavonoids and phenolic acids. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties.
